title: Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes
description: Bugs Bunny stands confidently in the center with one leg raised and hands clasped, smiling at the viewer. He is surrounded by other Looney Tunes characters including a smaller Bugs Bunny on the left, Yosemite Sam on the right with arms raised, a red-haired girl, and various small creatures and symbols like hearts, butterflies, and TNT boxes on a colorful painted ground.
prompt: A vibrant cartoon painting of Bugs Bunny standing center stage with one leg kicked up and hands together, smiling confidently at the viewer. To his left is a smaller version of himself with arms crossed, to his right is Yosemite Sam in a sombrero with fists raised. Scattered around are a red-haired girl, small creatures, butterflies, hearts, TNT boxes, and a white ball with 'RA' on it, all set against a colorful painterly background with grass and paint drips.
